card.name: Section numbers in dosing cross-references
card.fires_on: The digit or decimal point inside section cross-references like (2.4, 8.6) in highlights of prescribing information. It also fires on a few partway-through pieces of names and long words.

modes.label: Section reference
modes.description: The 2 or the period inside a numbered section citation after a dosing statement for organ impairment.

modes.label: Inside names
modes.description: Middle pieces of unusual personal or brand names or medical words.

card.plain: It marks the number in a section citation like (2.4) after a dosing statement, and occasionally the middle of a rare name.
